'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[United States|U.S.]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] says he is postponing his 48-hour [[ultimatum]] for five days before attacking the [[Iran]]ian [[List of power stations in Iran|power plants]] as Iran and the U.S. have held "very good and productive conversations" on ending the war. Trump also claims that a "major points of agreement" focused on Iran's renunciation of the [[Nuclear program of Iran|nuclear weapon]] are being talked. Iran denies any dialogue took place. [https://abcnews.com/Politics/trump-us-iran-major-points-agreement-including-nuclear/story?id=131323034 (ABC News)] [https://www.newsfromthestates.com/article/trump-claims-good-and-productive-talks-iran-about-war-iran-denies-negotiations (States Newsroom)]
***[[Iraq in the 2026 Iran war]]
****[[Kata'ib Hezbollah]] says that it will extend its pause on strikes on the [[United States]] [[Embassy of the United States, Baghdad|embassy]] in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], for five more days. [https://gulfnews.com/amp/story/world%2Fmena%2Firaqi-pro-iran-group-extends-pause-in-us-embassy-attacks-1.500483016 (AFP via ''Gulf News'')]
***A person is killed and another is injured in a strike on a [[Transmitter|transmission site]] of the Persian Gulf Radio and Television Centre in [[southern Iran]]. [https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/middleeastnews/917314/iran-media-says-one-dead-in-attack-on-broadcaster-in-coastal-region/en (AFP via LBCI)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****At least one person is killed in an [[Israel]]i strike on [[Hazmieh]], [[Greater Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] states that the attack targeted a member of Iran's [[Quds Force]] in the area. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/03/23/lebanon-says-one-killed-near-beirut-as-israel-says-struck-irgc-member (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***At least 15 people are killed and 23 others are injured in strikes on [[Lagawa District]], [[West Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. The [[Rapid Support Forces]] attribute the attack to the [[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese army]]. [https://www.brecorder.com/news/40412793/ongoing-hostilities-in-me-pm-conveys-to-pezeshkian-deep-concern (AFP via ''Business Recorder'')]
**A Sudanese rebel faction led by [[Yasir Arman]] calls for the [[United Nations Security Council]] to end the use of drones on [[Sudan|Sudanese]] citizens. [https://sudantribune.com/article/312029 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Brent crude]] futures fall 11%, trading just below [[United States dollar|US$]]100 a barrel for the first time in days, following the announcement by [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] about talks with Iran to end the war. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-prices-rise-after-us-iran-threaten-hit-energy-targets-middle-east-2026-03-22/ (Reuters)] 
**[[Slovenia]] becomes first [[EU]] country to introduce fuel rationing to cope with extra demand by drivers from neighboring countries. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c77m4zx6zvmo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Colombian Air Force Lockheed C-130 crash]]
**At least 66 people are killed when a [[Colombian Aerospace Force|military]] [[Lockheed C-130 Hercules|Lockheed C-130]], carrying 125 people, crashes in [[Puerto Leguízamo]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/3/24/at-least-66-dead-after-colombia-military-transport-plane-crashes-1015 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*At least one person is killed and several others are injured in an explosion in [[Kwara State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-deadly-explosion-kwara-muslim-militants-c592a8910b015fc58da24c42793cb595 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Climate crisis]]
**In its annual ''State of the Global Climate'' report, the [[World Meteorological Organization]] states that Earth's [[Energy balance (energy economics)|energy imbalance]] and [[ocean heat content]] reached record levels in 2025, driven by rising [[greenhouse gas emissions]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/heat-world-temperature-global-warming-6010916 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Bill Cosby sexual assault cases]]
**A [[Judiciary of the United States|U.S. civic court]] finds entertainer [[Bill Cosby]] [[Legal liability|liable]] for [[Rape in the United States|drugging and sexually assaulting]] a woman in 1972. The woman is awarded $59.25 million. [https://apnews.com/article/bill-cosby-verdict-sexual-assault-motsinger-83b384df93fd9bf862b553b19b5aa4f9 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1eq7v91n4xo (BBC News)]
*[[Climate change in Germany]], [[Phase-out of fossil fuel vehicles]]
**The [[Federal Court of Justice]] of [[Germany]] dismisses a lawsuit by [[Environmental Action Germany]] to ban [[BMW]] and [[Mercedes Benz]] from selling new [[Internal combustion engine|combustion engine]] vehicles after 2030. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-court-rejects-climate-case-against-bmw-mercedes/a-76485571 (DW)]
*[[Illegal drug trade in Puerto Rico]]
**[[Law enforcement in Puerto Rico|Puerto Rican police]] seize [[United States dollar|$]]12 million worth of [[cocaine]] found on a [[drug smuggling]] boat off [[Puerto Rico|the island]]'s northern coast. Three suspects are arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/puerto-rico-boat-drugs-seized-8b7e5f5d5f9c5903235a3385404fbff2 (AP)]
*As a reaction to the [[2026 Hatzola arson attack]], Belgium deploys ([[ISTAR]]) [[Jagers te Paard Battalion]], to guard Jewish "sites" and communities. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S3YMMQ_F9l8 (APT via YouTube)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Italian constitutional referendum]]
**In [[Italy]], the [[constitutional amendment]] that proposed to select members of the [[High Council of the Judiciary (Italy)|High Council of the Judiciary]] through [[sortition]] is rejected by a 46% to 54% vote. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/exit-polls-suggest-italys-meloni-has-narrowly-lost-justice-referendum-vote-2026-03-23/ (Reuters)]
*Following the [[2026 Laotian parliamentary election|February 22 elections]] to the [[National Assembly of Laos]], [[Thongloun Sisoulith]] is reelected as [[President of Laos|President of Laos]] and [[Sonexay Siphandone]] as [[Prime Minister of Laos|Prime Minister]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260323/56fffc5895d64a2aaf871772c6104d2b/c.html (Xinhua)] [https://english.news.cn/20260323/11ad6684da3a40c3ae31c2c7e4ca6dc9/c.html (Xinhua)]
